title: Qualification Requirements
text: Researching the learning and qualification requirements for jobs and careers that you are interested in.
cdi_links: 4.E.04 Researching the learning and qualification requirements for jobs and careers that they are interested in

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: What qualifications and training different careers require
The professional skills needed for various roles
How to create a simple action plan to reach your career goals

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can find reliable information about qualifications, skills, and training for a career that interests me
I can explain the professional skills and progression routes linked to my chosen career
I can create an action plan showing steps needed to work towards this career

title: Key Words
bullets: Qualification Level – The stage or difficulty level of a qualification (e.g., Level 2, Level 3, degree).
Training Route – The type of learning you take to gain skills for a job (e.g., college course, apprenticeship).
Transferable Skills – Abilities needed to do a job well, such as teamwork, communication, or problem-solving.

title: Understanding Career Requirements
bullets: Researching a job helps you understand the qualifications, training, and skills needed.
This helps you decide if the role suits you and plan your next steps.
Good research gives a clear picture of how to reach your goals.

title: What to Look For
bullets: Qualification Level: The level of study required (Level 2, Level 3, or degree).
Training Route: How you learn the job (college, apprenticeship, specialist course).
Transferable Skills: Skills employers want, like communication, teamwork, and problem-solving.

title: Activity 1 – Career Research
text:
Choose a career you are interested in. Research what qualifications, training, and transferable skills are needed.

Questions to answer:
- Which career have you chosen?
- What school subjects are helpful for this career?
- What learning pathway would be best for this career?
- What qualifications would you need after school?
- What transferable skills do employers look for?

title: Activity 2 – Action Plan
text: Make a simple action plan for someone wanting to follow this career.

title: Complete the sentence
sentence: Researching reliable information helps you make better ________ about education and career routes.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Understanding qualification requirements helps you prepare for your chosen career
Researching training routes and transferable skills gives a clear path to success
Creating an action plan helps you plan steps to achieve your career goals
